answer: Terraced admission blocks bulk fakes by raising each climb's price. A newcomer docks in a harbor pool at zero weight and must earn distinct endorsements before gaining weight. Each terrace locks more credits than the last: 20, then 40, then 80, so one identity costs 140 in total. The k-th fake still pays its own 140 plus a fresh trellis of endorsements, so 1,000 fakes cost 140,000, while shared endorsements are slashed as endorsement farming. An honest agent climbs once for full weight.
